footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to Southwest Gas: includes $200M from discontinued operations, $4.6M of losses allocated to noncontrolling interests.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue fell 21.6% to $1.9B in 2025. Operating income rose 16.6% to $474M, a 24.4% margin.
Net income rose 2.2× to $440M, or $6.08 per share. Operating cash flow was $556M and free cash flow −$252M, versus $509M; Southwest Gas returned $179M through dividends.
sources: Southwest Gas Holdings, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
